# TakeoffPro

> Digital quantity takeoff and construction inspection platform purpose-built for NJTA and NJDOT projects. Measure from PDF plans, track contract vs. measured quantities, and export audit-ready reports.

TakeoffPro replaces paper DC forms with audit-ready digital records. It supports the NJTA 7th Edition 2016 Standard Specifications and is used by Org Owners, Project Managers, and Field Inspectors.
